'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Tom Frafjord LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]]
* '''Username:''' citizenSwanky
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
